title: CSV export with date filters
request: Add an `export` command to ledgerlite that prints invoices as CSV. It must support --from and --to dates (YYYY-MM-DD, both inclusive) and an optional --status filter (open or paid). Rows are sorted by date, then id. Amounts always have two decimals. The CSV starts with the header id,customer,date,amount,status. An invalid date prints a clear error and exits with code 2. If nothing matches, print only the header. Document the command in the README.
acceptance: Date range is inclusive at both ends
Status filter keeps only matching invoices
Rows are sorted by date, then id
Amounts are printed with exactly two decimals
python -m ledger export prints CSV to stdout
Invalid dates exit with code 2 and a clear message
An empty result prints only the header
The README documents the export command

plan.title: Add date range and status filtering
Wire the export command into the CLI
Handle invalid dates and empty results
